plans/client-feed-prd.md.title: Client feed: a per-project, client-safe evidence feed for the client portal
plans/client-feed-prd.md.excerpt: A paying client opens their private link on the portal and watches their block take shape: whether the factory is running, what is in flight right now, every change that landed and when, every test run with per-test results, the acceptance criteria and their latest outcome, the client-visible source tree down to file names with line counts, and the files they chose to reveal, updated on every advance of main. Nothing from any other project, and nothing of the factory's own configuration, ever. The portal renders it; this PRD produces it.
